title: Recipes 4 Create: Station Decorations
description: Adds some recipes for the Platform Signs and more uncraftable blocks in Create: Station Decor
body:
!BEWARE THIS DATAPACK IS STILL IN ALPHA!</br>
Adds recipes for the Station Platform Blocks in Create: Station Decor. Each Station Platform Block has its own crafting recipe depending on their style.

To make Platform 2-8 Signs, you may put in a Platform Sign and craft it to their next Station Number. For example, Platform Sign 2 when put inside the crafting grid again can be crafted into Platform Sign 3. This pattern repeats until Platform Sign 9 which can be crafted back into Platform Sign 1 again.

# Dependancies
Create Mod | https://modrinth.com/mod/create</br>
Create: Station Decor | https://modrinth.com/mod/create-station-decor

# List of Supported Recipes
- Platform Signs
- More uncraftable items (soon)
